description: Image Description: The image features a garden scene with a terracotta sculpture of a voluptuous, abstract human figure. The sculpture is placed on grass and leans slightly against a lush, green apple tree with several apples visible among the leaves. The background is filled with greenery, suggesting a vibrant and healthy garden environment. Sunlight filters through the foliage, creating a soft and serene atmosphere. The sculpture stands out due to its earthy color and smooth texture, contrasting with the vibrant green of the surrounding plants.
